snippet.title: The Comyths — Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The Comyths is a reality-bending character-driven bullet-hell action game. Wield the fundamental forces of Space, Time, Matter, Life, Mind, and Void to rewrite the rules of combat. Chase S-ranks, unlock art rewards, and uncover hidden story logs.
